**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

## What looks good
- The fix is small and in the right place. The post gate (`posting_sim.rs`, not-judged arm) now calls `kept_moved` after `uncovered`. `kept_moved` calls `operation::kept_rejudge::moved_part_problem` for each program op.
- All post paths use one gate. The main post (`posting.rs:576`), per-op files (`posting_per_op.rs:153`), mounts (`posting_mounts.rs:221/223`) and the script API (`script/api.rs:248`) all call `verification_report_by`, which calls `sim_clause`. `program_ops` reads the whole program, so no path skips the live re-judge. `posting_setup_change.rs` does not gate by itself. It posts only after the same gate.
- No false refusal on an ordinary job. The re-judge runs only when the sim refuses to judge. It skips ops whose cached warnings already block (they are refused by their own findings). It skips ops with no kept parts. The pins also post after a part is moved away, and after a fixture is untagged and not moved. `stock_source_law::a_legal_stock_source_cut_stays_clean_and_posts_on_both_stocks` stays green.
- On an aligned stock the sim judges, so the `Ok` arm is unchanged.
- `stock_to_leave_of` is a move of the old table out of `run_job_arms`. Generation and the re-judge read one number.
- No `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!` in the new code. A job that cannot be collected again is refused (fail closed). Provenance line, Gate map, decision file, `Changelog:` line and `Fixes #1628` are present. No Cargo, process or snapshot files changed. `generate.rs` gets shorter (3604 to 3555 lines). New files are under 400 lines.

## Results (merged with main `upstream/main` 389fe96c, run locally on macOS; the runner API gave 403, so no runner run)
| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| `kept_parts_live` | 4 passed |
| `fixtures` | 14 passed |
| `fidelity_copies` | 6 passed |
| `stock_source_verdict` | 22 passed |
| `keep_law` | 8 passed |
| `neighbour_law` | 5 passed |
| `post_not_judged` | 4 passed |
| `stock_source_law` | 7 passed |
| `operations` | 119 passed, 6 ignored |
| `posting` | 17 passed |
| `per_op_files` | 9 passed |
| `setup_mounts_post` | 8 passed |
| `plasma_gate`, `area_controls`, `engrave_law`, `mark_floor` | 9, 13, 9, 6 passed |
| `camcraft-app --lib` | 278 passed |
| clippy `-p camcraft-app --all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

The three issue contracts (`workholding_never_stales_a_fresh_toolpath`, `a_frommodel_stock_survives_its_source_being_deleted`, `a_model_update_does_not_touch_a_box_stock`) are inside `fixtures` and `operations`. They pass.

Mutations that I ran again, each restored after:
1. Remove `.or_else(|| kept_moved(..))` in `posting_sim.rs`: 3 of 4 `kept_parts_live` tests red.
2. Make the `blocks_post` refusal in `moved_part_problem` never fire: 3 of 4 red.
3. Make the "no kept parts" early return always fire: 3 of 4 red.

The fourth pin (`a_part_moved_into_a_stock_source_cut_...never_posts`) stays green in all three. That is expected. A part move already stales a stock-source op through its stamp, so the post refuses with "regenerate" before the re-judge runs. It pins the stamp path, not the new code.

## Requested before merge
None.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)
1. The PR body still says "Stacked on #1622". #1622 has merged, so the diff is now only #1628's work (7 files). Please correct the body when you next edit it.
2. As the body says, the 3+2 (tilted) arm of `local_path` has no test. A later `P7` issue could add a fixture.
3. `kept_moved` re-collects the job for every op with a kept part set on each post. The cost is small, but it grows with the op count on a turned stock.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
